Classes.Definition:
---
Pages:
  # The individual tabs in AgentGovernanceObjectZoom are called Pages.
  # The fields to be displayed there are defined in the roles 
  # listed on the left under "Roles".
  - Name: Summary
    Layout:
      Columns: 2
      ColumnWidth: 1fr 1fr
    Interfaces:
      - Agent
    Content:
      - Section: General Fields::StateMap
        RowStart: 1
        ColumnStart: 1
      - Section: GovernanceDB Backlinks::Backlinks
        RowStart: 2
        ColumnStart: 1
      - Section: GovernanceDB Description::Description
        RowStart: 1
        RowSpan: 2
        ColumnStart: 2
        
Roles: 
  # Roles are used to define the Sections and their individual fields.
  # Of course, sections can also be defined directly here in the class definitions. 
  # We have simply moved them to "Roles" for the sake of clarity.

  # For each class with class-specific fields, there is a "General Fields"
  # definition referring to a role with the name "GovernanceDB GF class name". 
  # This is where the fields of the respective class can be customised.
  General Fields:
    Name: ZTSM State Book
  GovernanceDB Backlinks:
    Name: GovernanceDB Backlinks
  GovernanceDB Description:
    Name: GovernanceDB Description

RegExList.ErrorMessage: Please make sure is number and in sequential
